name: Agricultural Economics
summary: Research studies land, natural resources, food systems, and rural economic development, including the incentives that shape investment and conservation.
overview: Current work examines land tenure, farm investment, agricultural technology, climate risk, and the institutional conditions that influence production and environmental practices.

projects.title: Land Tenure and Soil Conservation in Peru: Evidence from Double/Debiased Machine Learning
projects.summary: Examines whether land titles support soil-conservation practices in Peru, combining agricultural census information with local institutional measures.
